game.name: ROBLOX: Longest Obby in Roblox | 1000+ Obstacles & Hangout
game.rules:
# VIDEO RULES

- Please make sure that the quality of your videos is 720p or higher.
- No splicing.
- The leaderboard must be visible at all times.

# GAME RULES

- Do not modify the game in order to gain advantages in your runs.
- Do not use any 3rd party tools like scripts or exploits that could help you to get better times. (FPS unlocker falls under this rule and is not allowed)
- Runs must show you **resetting** in the video recording.
- DO NOT SKIP CHECKPOINTS UNLESS IT IS A 5/10/20/50/100 STAGE RUN, ANY OTHER RUNS THAT SKIP STAGES WILL BE REJECTED.

A improved version of the game can be found here: https://www.roblox.com/games/5146117290/Longest-Obby-on-Roblox-1-000-Stages

categories.name: 1000 Stages
categories.rules:
Simply complete the obstacle course as fast as you can.

- The time starts when you enter the game. [Stage 1]

- The time stops at the last checkpoint on Stage 1000.

- No Bug/Hack using allowed.

- You may not use the "Skip this Stage" button, nor any of the items available in the shop.

- An outside timer must be used to time your run. Livesplit is recommended.

categories.name: 5 Stages
categories.rules:
Complete five stages as fast as you can.

- The time starts on first movement.

- The time stops at the last checkpoint on Stage 5.

- You may not use the "Skip this Stage" button, nor any of the items available in the shop.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Time starts when you move.
Time ends when your level counter is 1000.

you may use glitches as its the only way to reach it.

In order to verify your run, you may post a video showing your run. If you are unable to post the video due to size limitations, you are allowed to post a screenshot showing your character at the final stage and your splits.

categories.name: Dead%
categories.rules:
Time starts on first movement, time ends on death

May not use reset button

categories.name: Climb%
categories.rules:
Timer starts on first movement and ends on when you are on top of spawn building. 

Same rules as other categories

categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
You must reset before each run and it must be visible on the recording.

Time starts on the first frame of movement and ends on the first frame you touch the checkpoint.

No glitches are allowed whatsoever.

categories.name: Glitches
categories.rules:
You must reset before each run and it must be visible on the recording.

Time starts on the first frame of movement and ends on the first frame you touch the checkpoint.

Any glitches are allowed.

categories.name: Hangout%
categories.rules:
Get into the lounge/hangout on stage 1 as fast as possible.

Being off center on the spawn is fine as long as you show yourself resetting in the video recording.
